edges.reason: amount parameter flows into withdrawAmount spend logic
amount is forwarded to the external value transfer
msg.sender is the attacker-controlled recipient of the external transfer, enabling state-dependent reentry
withdrawAmount executes the raw transfer before any state reconciliation
The transferred-to address can call back into withdrawAmount or other contract functions
getBalance result is used in the withdrawAmount require check
withdrawAmount authorization depends on msg.sender == wallet
wallet is compared against the caller to authorize withdrawal
mintRelic performs the unchecked tokenCounter increment
ownermintRelic performs the unchecked tokenCounter increment
Increment result is written back into the tokenCounter state variable
tokenCounter is used as the minted tokenId in mintRelic
tokenCounter is used as the minted tokenId in ownermintRelic
saleStatus gates whether the public mintRelic can execute
collectionLock gates whether mintRelic can execute
collectionLock gates whether ownermintRelic can execute
msg.sender becomes the recipient of the minted token in mintRelic
msg.sender is compared to wallet to authorize ownermintRelic
wallet is the trusted comparison value for the admin mint check
changeRelicURI authorization relies on msg.sender == wallet
wallet is compared against the caller before changing the URI
startSale authorization relies on msg.sender == wallet
wallet is compared against the caller before starting the sale
stopSale authorization relies on msg.sender == wallet
wallet is compared against the caller before stopping the sale
lockcollection authorization relies on msg.sender == wallet
wallet is compared against the caller before locking the collection
inputURI parameter is consumed by changeRelicURI
inputURI is written into the relicURI state variable
relicURI is assigned as the token URI during minting
relicURI is assigned as the token URI during admin minting
newOwner parameter is consumed by transferOwnership
transferOwnership delegates the ownership write to _setOwner
renounceOwnership delegates the ownership write to _setOwner
_setOwner enforces msg.sender == wallet before writing ownership
newOwner becomes the new privileged owner written in _setOwner
_setOwner copies the previous _owner into a local variable
oldOwner local reads the previous _owner value
_setOwner writes the privileged _owner state variable
The constructor calls _setOwner to bind the privileged wallet as owner
The constructor initializes tokenCounter to 1

normalization_plan.reason: amount is only meaningful as the input of the withdrawAmount call chain and should be folded into that core function/unsafe operation.
inputURI is a transient string argument that is directly stored by changeRelicURI and can be merged into that core function.
newOwner is the sole argument forwarded to transferOwnership and can be absorbed into that core function.
oldOwner is a temporary local inside _setOwner with no independent semantics and should be merged into the core function.
